title: Interview: John Lennon and Yoko Ono for New Music Magazine | 1973
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono gave an interview to New Music Magazine on 5 July 1973.

The journalist for the Japanese publication was Yuya Uchida. The interview took place at the Dakota Building, Lennon and Ono’s new home in Manhattan.

This was the second stage of the interview, with the first part taking place on 5 July. Uchida also attended an Ono recording session at the Record Plant on 6 July.
